entry.p: Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist detects vehicles approaching from the rear left or right while your vehicle is reversing and warns you of a possible collision with a warning message and a warning sound. Also, Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist may assist with braking your vehicle to help avoid a collision.

li.p: Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist operating range
Rear Cross-Traffic Collision Warning operating range

note.p: Warning timing may vary depending on vehicle speed of the approaching vehicle.
